battle.name: 羅斯—拜占庭戰爭 (907年)
battle.theater: 君士坦丁堡城牆與博斯普魯斯海峽
battle.brief: 公元907年，羅斯首領奧列格率瓦良格人與斯拉夫人船隊自第聶伯河入黑海，掃掠色雷斯後兵臨君士坦丁堡，包圍卻因海風覆舟而功敗。事後羅斯受洗並立約納貢，成為拜占庭的「羅馬臣僕」；卡面的羅馬重步兵屬一千年前的兵制，九世紀的拜占庭重裝近戰已由持矛兵與卡塔夫拉克托伊重騎承擔。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰的兩方是東歐的基輔羅斯聯盟與東羅馬的拜占庭帝國。羅斯一方並非單一國家，而是以瓦良格人（北歐來的海掠者）為核心，由東歐斯拉夫諸部與其北面的芬蘭—波伏里亞系部落臨時結成的聯軍；最高統率者是諾沃哥羅德公爵奧列格，據俄羅斯《往紀》，他於882年取基輔，把散處於第聶伯河中游的斯拉夫部眾收束在一處。編制上沒有常備軍與固定兵員，各部首領自帶一隊戰士，兵員在春末夏初結集，戰利品、婦孺與牲畜隨船同行，季節一過即散。拜占庭方面是馬其頓王朝的帝國：皇帝利奧六世（886至912年在位）與共治太子君士坦丁七世，軍力由數支帝國直屬軍區（tagmata）構成，包括持矛的斯基拉泰與普西洛伊、披重甲的卡塔夫拉克托伊重騎，以及托克索泰弓兵，另有各行省的軍區部隊與帝國海軍的德龍戰船。第三方同樣重要：保加爾的西米恩一世在同一年從色雷斯與馬其頓方向進攻，帝國海軍上將希拉里翁又因欠餉在金角灣舉兵，907年的拜占庭並非處於最穩當的狀態。背景則是860年羅斯第一次襲擊君士坦丁堡之後被確立的臣屬關係，希臘史料此後直接稱羅斯人為「羅馬的臣僕」。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Kievan Rus' confederation in eastern Europe and the Byzantine Empire, the Eastern Roman state. The Rus' side was not a single country but a coalition put together on the spot around the Varangians, Scandinavian raiders and seaborne pirates, together with the East Slavic tribes and the Finnish and Permian peoples to their north; overall command belonged to Oleg, prince of Novgorod, who according to the Russian Primary Chronicle took Kiev in 882 and drew the scattered Slavic communities of the middle Dnieper together under one rule. There was no standing army and no fixed establishment: each clan leader brought his own band, the warriors mustered in late spring and early summer, and the plunder, the captive women and children and the animals travelled with the fleet and dispersed again once the season was over. On the Byzantine side stood the empire of the Macedonian dynasty: Emperor Leo VI (886 to 912) and his co-reigning son Constantine VII, with the military strength resting in the tagmata, the standing armies of the imperial districts, namely the spearmen called skoutatoi and psiloi, the heavily armoured kataphraktoi cavalry and the toxotoi archers, supplemented by the district troops of the provinces and by the dromons of the imperial navy. Third parties matter here: Simeon I of Bulgaria attacked from the Thrace and Macedonian fronts in the same year, and the Byzantine admiral Hilarion mutinied in the Golden Horn over unpaid wages, so 907 was not a moment at which the empire stood at its strongest. Behind everything lies the relationship fixed by the Rus' raid on Constantinople in 860, after which the Greek sources call the Rus' outright Servants of the Romans.
people: 決定走向的是羅斯首領奧列格。按俄羅斯《往紀》，他在907年率大軍沿第聶伯河而下，兵臨君士坦丁堡，在那裡受洗並與希臘人立約，史家因此稱他為「先知」奧列格。他並非憑一場勝利取得這些條件：《往紀》記載圍城之際羅斯軍中流行傳染病，奧列格趁希臘人願意談判之際換得納貢條款與洗禮，隨後把船隊帶回第聶伯河上游，912年前後卒於基輔，把基輔的權位交給伊戈爾。拜占庭方面，皇帝利奧六世「智者」是名義上的決策者，但907年他正被希拉里翁的兵變、保加利亞的進攻與宮廷人事折騰牽制，真正出面與羅斯交涉的是皇室派出的代表，帝國實權此時集中於萊卡佩諾斯家族一支。關鍵的第二號人物是歐克西年，這位出身喬治亞的宦官在利奧六世末年出任海軍總督（megas doux），911年羅斯再度來犯時，據尼塞塔斯·喬尼亞特斯記載，是他在第聶伯河擊敗羅斯船隊，隨後的條約談判也由他經手；927年他登上皇位，成為拜占庭史上唯一一位出身奴隸的皇帝。希臘方面留下的記載者有狄奧菲尼·克里奧諾里與編纂於911年的希臘編年史，兩者的敘述構成本役最核心的材料來源；俄羅斯方面的《往紀》則把同一件事寫成奧列格的道德事蹟。
peopleEn: What decided the course of the affair was the Rus' leader Oleg. According to the Russian Primary Chronicle, in 907 he led a great army down the Dnieper to Constantinople, where he was baptised and concluded a treaty with the Greeks; historians therefore call him Oleg the Prophet. He did not win these terms in battle: the Chronicle records that a contagious disease ran through the Rus' host during the siege, and Oleg used the willingness of the Greeks to negotiate to obtain the tribute clauses and his own baptism, then took his fleet back up the Dnieper; he died at Kiev around 912, leaving the rule of Kiev to Igor. On the Byzantine side Emperor Leo VI the Wise was the nominal decision-maker, but in 907 he was absorbed by the mutiny of Hilarion, the Bulgarian advance and the manoeuvring of the court, and the representatives of the imperial house were the ones who actually dealt with the Rus'; the real authority lay meanwhile with the branch of the Lekapenos family. The second key figure is Eudokia, the Georgian-born eunuch who served as megas doux, the admiral, in the last years of Leo VI; according to Niketas Choniates it was he who defeated the Rus' fleet on the Dnieper in 911 and who then handled the treaty negotiations, and in 927 he took the throne, the only Byzantine emperor to rise from slavery. The Greek side left us Theophanes Confessor and the Greek Chronicle compiled in 911, and their accounts are the core of the source base for this war; the Primary Chronicle on the Russian side turns the same event into a moral exemplum for Oleg.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬重步兵屬於共和末年至帝國初年的兵種：分段鎧甲（segmentata）覆於軀幹，配一面可遮住身體的大重盾（scutum），近戰靠短劍與刺針（hasta velitaris）；卡面文字點出的重點是，羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與維持補給線，而不是靠重裝本身。它與907年相隔約一千零一百年，本場戰爭的現場不可能出現這件裝備：西羅馬的軍隊於476年消失，帝國的步兵制度在數百年間反覆重裝化又輕裝化，最後定型為拜占庭的持矛步兵，東西方的重步兵傳統早已斷絕。真正上手的是三套不同的兵器體系。羅斯方面是瓦良格斧兵與東歐斯拉夫斧兵：單手戰斧、短直刀與柳葉形單手劍、長矛、木製圓盾或橢圓盾，配皮甲或稀疏的鎖子甲，遠程用榆木複合弓；沒有重騎，沒有攻城塔與破城槌，能帶走的只有人和戰利品。拜占庭方面是帝國的持矛步兵配直刃短劍與小圓盾、托克索泰弓兵用反曲複合弓與箭、卡塔夫拉克托伊重騎用長矛與覆甲的鎧具；帝國自九世紀末起已在少數部隊列裝火器，包括手炮與火矢，但數量稀少，907年時只是新奇補充。攻城方面，拜占庭靠狄奧菲西城牆、塔樓、弩炮與投石機，以及德龍戰船的撞角與火攻手段，羅斯一方則是無帆的划槳大船，靠突襲登陸與劫掠取勝。
kitsEn: The Roman heavy infantry on the card belongs to the late Republic and early Empire: a segmented cuirass (segmentata) over the torso, with a large shield (scutum) able to cover the body, fighting with the short sword and the thrusting spear (hasta velitaris). The point the card makes is that Rome's strength lay in replenishing manpower and keeping supply lines open, not in the heaviness of the equipment. It stands roughly a thousand and one years away from 907 and could not have been present in this campaign: the Western Roman army ceased to exist in 476, the infantry system of the empire was re-armoured and re-lightened repeatedly over the centuries, and what finally settled into place in the eastern Mediterranean was Byzantine spear infantry; the tradition of heavy infantry had long since been broken. What actually went into the fighting were three separate sets of arms. On the Rus' side were Varangian and East Slavic axemen: one-handed war axes, short straight knives and single-edged willow-leaf swords, spears, wooden round or oval shields, leather armour or thin mail, and elm composite bows for the range; there were no heavy cavalry, no siege towers and no rams, and all they could carry away was men and plunder. On the Byzantine side the spearmen, skoutatoi and psiloi, carried straight spathed swords and small round shields, the toxotoi shot with reflex composite bows, and the kataphraktoi cavalry used long kontos spears and armour for horse and rider; from the late ninth century the empire also had a small number of firearms in service, hand cannon and fire-arrows, but they were rare novelties in 907 and not a main force. On the assault, Byzantium had the Theodosian walls, their towers, bolt-throwers and stone-throwers, together with the rams and the fire of the dromons; the Rus' had flat-bottomed rowing boats without sails and could win only by surprise landings and plunder.
tactics: 羅斯採取的是典型的季節性海陸掠奪作戰：先在第聶伯河上游的集結點編船，順流而下入黑海，沿海北岸航行並在克里米亞、刻赤一帶取水補給，越過博斯普魯斯海峽後在色雷斯登陸，分成數隊各循一段海岸線劫掠，目標包括城郊村落、修道院與商船，而非攻城本身；騎兵與斥候在陸路掃蕩，奪取牲畜與俘虜返回船上。但一旦艦隊進入博斯普魯斯海峽，攻擊重心就轉向首都：狄奧菲西城牆高厚，背後有內城與護城河，羅斯沒有攻城器械，只能以人海貼牆強攻，而海峽內狹窄的水面既限制了登岸點，也讓德龍戰船得以橫切船隊，隨後的暴風更摧毀了泊在岸邊的羅斯船隻，狄奧菲尼記為上帝的審判。拜占庭的戰術因此是拖、談、殲三段式：以海軍巡邏與岸防遲滯進攻的節奏，避開在色雷斯平原與敵主力正面碰撞；待風暴解決了對手的舟師之後，再以海軍在第聶伯河下游攔截殘部，911年一役全殲羅斯船隊，取得決定性的海上優勢，最後以使節和約把衝突收束成制度化的納貢關係。
tacticsEn: The Rus' campaign was a typical seasonal raid carried by sea and land: the fleet was assembled at a mustering point on the upper Dnieper, floated down the river into the Black Sea, hugged the northern shore and took in water around Crimea and Kerch, and after passing the Bosporus put ashore in Thrace, where it split into bands that swept separate stretches of coast, the objectives being villages, monasteries and trading ships rather than the taking of a fortress; horsemen and outriders swept the land for cattle and captives and drove them back to the boats. But once the fleet entered the Bosporus the centre of gravity shifted to the capital: the Theodosian walls were tall and thick and backed by an inner citadel and a moat, the Rus' had no siege engines and could only throw men against the wall, and the narrow water inside the strait both restricted the landing points and let the dromons cross the line of the fleet, after which a storm destroyed the Rus' ships lying along the shore, which Theophanes calls a judgement of God. The Byzantine method was therefore one of delay, negotiation and destruction in three stages: the navy patrolled and the shore defence slowed the tempo of the attack, avoiding a general engagement with the Rus' main body on the open ground of Thrace; the storm having already disposed of the enemy's shipping, the fleet was concentrated at the mouth of the Dnieper to intercept the remnants, and in 911 it destroyed the Rus' fleet there, gaining a decisive advantage at sea; the matter was then closed by negotiation, and the tribute relationship was turned into an institutional arrangement.
data: 可核的數字並不多，而且多半不是兵員數。《往紀》與狄奧菲尼都沒有留下907年羅斯大軍的兵力數字，狄奧菲尼只用大批、海面為之蔽一類的形容，希臘方面同樣沒有為這場戰爭記下確切的傷亡，任何具體到個位的死傷數字都屬後人推算，不應當作史實。能確定的是幾個時間點與條款：860年羅斯第一次襲擊君士坦丁堡並被定為納貢；907年奧列格大舉來犯、包圍首都而失敗；911年羅斯再犯，在第聶伯河被擊敗，隨後簽訂新約；941年伊戈爾停止納貢、戰爭全面爆發，944年的條約重新確認納貢，羅斯此後約半個世紀安分，直到971年才再度大舉出兵。地理上，羅斯船隊自第聶伯河口到博斯普魯斯海峽的直線海路約一千五百公里，因需貼黑海北岸繞行，實際航程更長；自基輔順流而下到出海歷時以數日計，逆流返回則遠為艱難，沿途正是《往紀》所記必須由人拖曳而過的瀑布暗礁所在。制度性的數字則是納貢與嫁妝錢：羅斯按年交付絲綢、錢幣、蜜蠟、獸皮與俘虜，拜占庭則每年支付一筆用於希臘女子嫁入羅斯家庭的補償金。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and most of them are not headcounts. Neither the Primary Chronicle nor Theophanes gives a number for the size of the Rus' host in 907; Theophanes uses only descriptions such as a vast multitude and the sea covered by ships, and the Greek side likewise records no exact losses for this war, so any casualty count given to the unit is a later reconstruction and should not be treated as fact. What can be fixed are a few dates and clauses: 860, when the Rus' first raided Constantinople and were turned into tributaries; 907, when Oleg came in force, besieged the capital and failed; 911, when the Rus' came again, were beaten on the Dnieper and signed a new treaty; 941, when Igor stopped the tribute and full-scale war began, and the treaty of 944, which restored the tribute, after which the Rus' kept quiet for about half a century until the great campaign of 971. Geographically, the straight sea run from the mouth of the Dnieper to the Bosporus is about fifteen hundred kilometres, and longer as the fleet hugged the northern shore of the Black Sea; the passage from Kiev down to the sea took a number of days, while the return against the current was far harder, and it was there that the rapids stood which the Chronicle says had to be dragged past by men. The institutional figures are the tribute and the dowry money: the Rus' delivered silk, coin, wax, hides and captives each year, while Byzantium paid an annual compensation for Greek women who married into Rus' households.
cause: 直接起因是羅斯不甘心只當羅馬的臣僕。860年第一次襲擊之後，希臘文獻把羅斯人寫成帝國的納貢者，羅斯商船須取得拜占庭的通行憑證，掠奪者的船隊不得越過第聶伯河與多瑙河，也不能進入帝國控制的刻赤海峽；到了九世紀末，這套限制越來越難忍受。瓦良格人與東歐斯拉夫人的進軍是一種季節性經濟：春天結集，夏天出掠，秋天回返，戰利品與俘虜是唯一的回報，羅斯人需要能反覆掠奪而不被攔截的海域，也需要帝國承認他們的地位。拜占庭一方則有另一套難題：利奧六世面對三重壓力，希拉里翁的海軍兵變、保加利亞人在西線的進攻，以及阿拉伯人在東線隨時可能重啟的戰事，帝國沒有餘力為一次黑海遠征耗盡海軍，因此傾向用以金錢買安寧的方式處理羅斯，也就是維持納貢、支付嫁妝錢、給予通商權，換取羅斯不越界。學界另有一種假說，認為907年的行動與拜占庭同阿拔斯的代理人戰爭有關，羅斯被某一方僱傭來牽制帝國，但這只是解釋框架，沒有直接史料可以坐實。
causeEn: The immediate cause was that the Rus' were unwilling to remain servants of the Romans. After the first raid of 860 the Greek sources wrote the Rus' down as tributaries: Rus' trading ships needed passes from Byzantium, the raiders' fleets were not to pass the Dnieper or the Danube, and they were not to enter the Kerch strait under imperial control; by the end of the ninth century these restrictions had become increasingly hard to endure. The campaigns of the Varangians and the East Slavs were a seasonal economy: muster in spring, plunder in summer, return in autumn, with plunder and captives the only return on the venture, so the Rus' needed a stretch of sea they could raid again and again without interception, and they needed the empire to acknowledge their standing. Byzantium had a different difficulty: Leo VI faced pressure on three fronts at once, the naval mutiny of Hilarion, the Bulgarian advance in the west, and the Arab threat in the east that could restart at any moment, and the empire had no strength to exhaust its fleet on a Black Sea expedition; it therefore tended to settle the Rus' question by buying quiet with money, keeping up the tribute, paying the dowry money and granting trading rights in exchange for the Rus' keeping off. Scholars have advanced a further hypothesis, that the operations of 907 formed part of the Byzantine and Arab proxy war and that the Rus' were hired by one side to pin the empire down, but that remains a frame of interpretation with no direct source to support it.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是把羅斯與拜占庭的關係固定成一套雙邊制度。911至912年的條款在往後數百年裡幾乎原樣延續：羅斯人不得越過第聶伯河與多瑙河，拜占庭每年支付嫁妝錢，並維持羅斯人進入帝國通商與受洗的權利。對羅斯而言，這比一次軍事勝利更有價值，奧列格受洗，等於基輔的權力拿到了帝國的認可，羅斯從此自稱羅馬與希臘的臣僕，而且幾乎每一代羅斯王公都要爭取拜占庭的洗禮與榮譽，這條線一直通到988年弗拉季米爾受洗，並在拜占庭文獻裡被寫成皇帝的人。對拜占庭而言，黑海北岸從此多了一個可以攔截、可以贖買的對象，克里米亞的赫爾松在871年之後設督軍，刻赤海峽的關稅與巡邏也逐步收緊；海軍改革則在歐克西年任內展開，重裝德龍與改編的划槳手編制，正是針對北面海峽的威脅而來。長遠看，907年的失敗並沒有終止羅斯的海上進攻，911年、941年、971年、1043年的戰爭接連而來，直到十一世紀中葉羅斯人改以瓦良格人傭兵的身分成為帝國效力，掠奪者與僱傭兵之間的界線才逐漸模糊。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was to fix the relationship between Rus' and Byzantium into a bilateral system. The clauses of 911 to 912 were repeated almost unchanged for centuries afterwards: the Rus' might not pass the Dnieper or the Danube, and Byzantium paid the dowry money each year while preserving the Rus' right of access to imperial trade and to baptism. For the Rus' this was worth more than a military victory, for Oleg's baptism gave the authority of Kiev the empire's recognition, the Rus' henceforth called themselves servants of the Romans and the Greeks, and almost every generation of Rus' princes sought the Byzantine baptism and the honours that went with it, a line that runs right through to the baptism of Vladimir in 988, by which time the Greek records styled him servant of the emperor. For Byzantium, the northern shore of the Black Sea now had a counterparty who could be intercepted and could be bought, the command at Cherson in Crimea followed the establishment of the strategos there in 871, and the dues and the patrols of the Kerch strait were tightened in turn; the reform of the navy went ahead under Eudokia, the heavy dromons and the reorganised oarage being directed precisely at the northern threat from the straits. In the longer term the failure of 907 did not end the Rus' seaborne offensive: the wars of 911, 941, 971 and 1043 followed one another, and only in the middle of the eleventh century, as the Rus' took service in the empire as Varangian mercenaries, did the line between pirate and mercenary grow blurred.
result: 就907年本身而言，結果是羅斯攻勢的失敗與關係的制度化。狄奧菲尼記載羅斯人劫掠了色雷斯與伯羅奔尼撒的海岸，包圍了皇帝的城市，但隨後的海風毀掉了他們的船隊，進攻以崩潰收場；奧列格沒有攻下君士坦丁堡，卻在談判中取得了比860年更有利的條款，並且受洗，把羅斯的名分從劫掠者提升為受洗的臣僕。真正決定長期格局的是911年的那一戰：羅斯再度沿第聶伯河出動，在下游被拜占庭海軍在歐克西年指揮下擊敗，舟師覆沒，於是願意接受和約，重新按年納貢並接受嫁妝錢，這份安排維持了三十年，直到941年伊戈爾單方面停繳、兩國再度開戰，944年的條約才又把它撿回來。從兵器史的角度看，這場戰爭說明九世紀末東地中海的衝突形態：進攻方沒有羅馬式的重步兵方陣，也沒有攻城器械，靠的是划槳船隊與斧矛；防守方靠的也不是城牆上的步兵，而是海軍、封鎖與外交。卡面那件分段鎧甲配重盾的羅馬重步兵所代表的傳統，到907年早已散場，它留下的只有一種提醒，羅馬人的辦法從來是兵源與補給線，而不是重裝。
resultEn: For 907 itself the result was the failure of the Rus' offensive and the institutionalisation of the relationship. Theophanes records that the Rus' ravaged the coasts of Thrace and the Peloponnese and besieged the emperor's city, but that a sea-wind then destroyed their fleet and the attack collapsed; Oleg did not take Constantinople, yet in the negotiations he obtained terms more favourable than those of 860, and he was baptised, which lifted the Rus' nameplate from raider to baptised servant. What really settled the long-term pattern was the battle of 911: the Rus' came down the Dnieper again, were beaten on the lower river by the Byzantine fleet under Eudokia, lost their shipping, and were willing to take the treaty, resuming the annual tribute and accepting the dowry money, an arrangement that held for thirty years until 941, when Igor unilaterally stopped paying and the two states went to war again and the treaty of 944 had to pick the arrangement up once more. From the point of view of the history of arms, this war shows the shape of conflict in the eastern Mediterranean at the end of the ninth century: the attacker had no Roman-style heavy infantry phalanx and no siege engines, but rowing fleets, axes and spears; the defender relied not on infantry on the walls but on the navy, on blockade and on diplomacy. The tradition represented by the card's segmented cuirass and heavy shield had long since left the stage by 907; what it leaves behind is one reminder, that the Roman way was always men and supply lines, not heavy armour.
